Each row gets a small "Delete" Button (variant="ghost", size="sm") that is disabled (and shows a tooltip "Build in progress") when d.status is pending or building. On click, show an inline confirmation row or window.confirm dialog asking "Delete deployment from [date]? This cannot be undone." On confirm, call DELETE /api/deployments/{d.id}, then reload the deployments list. Show a brief error message if the request fails.
